'''Dawson Dill''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Los Gatos tournament]] on 24 February 2001 with Death Star: War Room start, according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1783">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-los-gatos-ca-2-24-01d1783/ los-gatos-ca-2-24-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-los-gatos-ca-2-24-01d1783/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
